item.title: IRGC challenges Trump’s Hormuz claim, warns US warships could be hit
item.description: Iran has challenged Washington over the Strait of Hormuz as tensions escalate between Tehran and the Trump administration. An IRGC Navy official reportedly dared the U.S. to send a warship near Hormuz, warning that Iranian forces were monitoring naval activity across the Persian Gulf and Gulf of Oman. Ali Mohammadi also warned that any renewed war could see Iranian attacks on U.S. vessels and destroyers, potentially extending toward American naval assets in the Indian Ocean. The warning came after the Trump administration rejected Iran’s proposal linked to reopening the Strait of Hormuz, while the Wall Street Journal reported that Trump expected U.S. bombing of Iran to resume after the November midterm elections.

item.title: Watch: Houthis' deadly Rajum drones track & strike Saudi-backed military buildup
item.description: Houthi-linked footage reportedly showed Rajum drones targeting Saudi military positions, armoured vehicles and fortified sites. The Houthis claimed the drones tracked Saudi troops and struck forces while they were building trenches and strengthening defensive positions. Press TV reported that the group described Rajum as a domestically developed reconnaissance-strike drone capable of tracking targets before dropping high-explosive projectiles. The footage and claimed damage have not been independently verified.
